recentItems.title: Pakistan-Afghanistan tensions: Airstrikes and retaliatory attacks intensify
recentItems.description:
Tensions are escalating between Pakistan and Afghanistan as both sides exchange attacks. Pakistan says it carried out airstrikes on 10 sites in Afghanistan, claiming they were used to launch drone attacks.

Al Jazeera’s Minelle Fernandez reports.

recentItems.title: Migrants report abuse in Ceuta: Spanish authorities deny allegations of mistreatment
recentItems.description:

Al Jazeera’s Peter Smith reports.
